concept_summary: A warm, unhurried home moment: his hands tuck the message card into the Signature Box, she opens it and reads the card first — her reaction is genuine, not performed — and only then does the necklace come into focus. The card, not the jewelry, is the visual and emotional center of every frame it shares.

shot_list.description: Close-up of a man's hands tucking a handwritten message card into the Signature Box, gold ribbon visible at the frame edge
shot_list.setting: warm home interior, kitchen counter, morning
shot_list.lighting: soft natural window light, warm tone
shot_list.product_placement: Signature Box centered in frame, message card mid-tuck, gold foil detail catching the light

shot_list.description: She opens the Signature Box and reads the message card first; her expression softens into genuine emotion before she notices the necklace beneath it
shot_list.setting: same warm home interior, seated at the counter
shot_list.lighting: soft natural window light, warm tone
shot_list.product_placement: message card in sharp focus first, necklace visible in the box beneath it, slightly soft
shot_list.wardrobe: soft knit sweater, neutral cream tone

shot_list.description: Macro close-up of the necklace resting in the Signature Box beside the now-read message card
shot_list.setting: same counter, shallow depth of field
shot_list.lighting: soft natural window light, warm tone
shot_list.product_placement: necklace and message card sharing the frame, card still legible but out of focus
